unitTitle: The Loch Ness Monster — Episode 1: The Accident
scanNote:
24-BET. 'The Loch Ness Monster' hikoyasining 1-epizodi — 'The Accident' (komiks).

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. Kirish matni va o'n uch gap pufakchasi TO'LIQ va TO'G'RI ko'chirilgan.

VOQEALAR TARTIBI:
  1) 'IN THE MORNING SUN OFFICES...' — Mayk gazetani ko'rsatadi
  2) Mayk: bugun hamma gazetada Loch Ness maxluqi haqida hikoya bor, LEKIN SURAT YO'Q. Loch Nessga boringlar!
  3) 'ON THE TRAIN...' — Sandra: 'Is there really a monster, David?' → 'Maybe!'
  4) 'AT LOCH NESS...' — maxluq ko'rinmaydi, qayiq ijaraga olishadi
  5) 'AFTER THREE HOURS ON THE BOAT...' — Devid maxluqni ko'radi
  6) Sandra o'rnidan turadi, Devid ogohlantiradi: 'Be careful! Sit down!'
  7) 'VROOOOM' — boshqa qayiq o'tadi, Sandra suvga yiqiladi: 'HELP ME!'

⚠ TO'RT QAHRAMON: Sandra Manning (jurnalist), David Parr (jurnalist), Mike Battle (muharrir), gazeta nomi — 'The Morning Sun'.
  ⚠ 'an editor' = muharrir (gazetani boshqaruvchi), 'a reporter' = jurnalist.

⚠ EPIZODNING GRAMMATIK MAQSADI — 3-unitning qoidalari amalda:
  'There ARE stories ... but there AREN'T ANY photographs' (there is/are + some/any)
  'IS THERE really a monster?' (savol shakli)
  'CAN you see the monster?' → 'No, I CAN'T' (can va qisqa javob)
  'Sit down! Don't stand up!' (buyruq gapning tasdiq va inkor shakli)

⚠ 'LET'S hire a boat' — taklif qilish qolipi ('let us' qisqartmasi).

⚠ SARLAVHA MA'NOSI: 'The Accident' = baxtsiz hodisa. Epizod aynan shu bilan tugaydi — Sandra suvga yiqiladi.
  ⚠ Davomi 46-betda ('The Wrong Photograph').

exercises.instructionEn: Sandra Manning and David Parr are reporters. They work for The Morning Sun in London. Mike Battle is the editor of the newspaper.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU NIMA?
Enterprise kitobida har bir moduldan keyin RASMLI HIKOYA keladi.
U unit emas — alohida epizod. Hikoya butun kitob davomida davom etadi.

1-EPIZOD: 'The Accident' (Baxtsiz hodisa)
Mavzu: Loch Ness ko'lidagi afsonaviy maxluq.

LOCH NESS — Shotlandiyadagi katta va chuqur ko'l.
'Loch' — shotlandcha 'ko'l' degani.
Afsonaga ko'ra u yerda 'Nessie' laqabli ulkan maxluq yashaydi.
Bu haqda 1930-yillardan beri gapiriladi, lekin ishonchli dalil yo'q.

QAHRAMONLAR:
  Mike Battle   — muharrir (editor)
  Sandra Manning — muxbir (reporter)
  David Parr     — muxbir (reporter)
  The Morning Sun — gazeta nomi

sentences.en: Sandra Manning and David Parr are reporters.
sentences.uz: Sandra Manning va Devid Parr — muxbirlar.
sentences.noteUz: reporter — gazeta yoki televideniye uchun yangilik yig'uvchi.

sentences.en: They work for The Morning Sun in London.
sentences.uz: Ular Londondagi 'The Morning Sun' gazetasida ishlaydi.
sentences.noteUz: 'work FOR' — biror tashkilotda ishlamoq. Gazeta nomi qiya yoziladi.

sentences.en: Mike Battle is the editor of the newspaper.
sentences.noteUz: editor — muharrir, gazetaning boshlig'i. U muxbirlarga topshiriq beradi.

exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni o'qing — har bir rasm va gapning tarjimasi berilgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYA TARTIBI (rasmlar bo'yicha):
  1) Gazeta idorasida — Mayk muxbirlarni chaqiradi
  2) Mayk topshiriq beradi — Loch Nessga borish
  3) Poyezdda — Sandra shubhalanadi
  4) Loch Nessda — qayiq ijaraga olishadi
  5) Uch soatdan keyin — maxluq paydo bo'ladi
  6) Sandra suvga yiqiladi — BAXTSIZ HODISA

DIQQAT — bu epizodda BUYRUQ GAPLARI juda ko'p:
  Look at this!    Go to Loch Ness!    Sit down!
  Be careful!      Don't stand up!     Help me!
Ular 25-betdagi 'The Imperative' qoidasida tushuntiriladi.

sentences.en: IN "THE MORNING SUN" OFFICES... — Sandra! David! Look at this.
sentences.uz: 'THE MORNING SUN' IDORASIDA... — Sandra! Devid! Bunga qarang.
sentences.noteUz: Mayk gapiryapti. 'Look at this' — buyruq gapi.

sentences.en: There are stories about the Loch Ness Monster in all the papers today, but there aren't any photographs!
sentences.uz: Bugun barcha gazetalarda Loch Ness maxluqi haqida maqolalar bor, lekin hech qanday surat yo'q!
sentences.noteUz: Unit 3 grammatikasi! There are ... but there aren't ANY ... . 'papers' = 'newspapers' ning qisqasi.

sentences.en: Go to Loch Ness. I want a story and photographs with it!
sentences.uz: Loch Nessga boringlar. Menga maqola va u bilan birga suratlar kerak!

sentences.en: ON THE TRAIN... — Is there really a monster, David?
sentences.uz: POYEZDDA... — Rostdan ham maxluq bormi, Devid?
sentences.noteUz: 'Is there ...?' — Unit 3 savol shakli. 'really' = rostdan ham.

sentences.en: AT LOCH NESS... — Can you see the monster?
sentences.noteUz: 'Can you see ...?' — ko'rish qobiliyati haqida savol.

sentences.en: No, I can't. Let's hire a boat and look for it.
sentences.uz: Yo'q, ko'rmayapman. Qayiq ijaraga olib, uni qidiraylik.

sentences.en: AFTER THREE HOURS ON THE BOAT... — Sandra! Look! The monster! Can you see it? Wow! It's huge!
sentences.uz: QAYIQDA UCH SOATDAN KEYIN... — Sandra! Qara! Maxluq! Ko'ryapsanmi? Voy! U ulkan!

sentences.en: Where is it? I can't see it! Quick, take some photographs!
sentences.uz: U qayerda? Men ko'rmayapman! Tez bo'l, suratga ol!
sentences.noteUz: 'Quick' va 'take' — buyruq. 'take a photograph' = suratga olmoq.

sentences.en: Sandra, be careful! Sit down! Don't stand up!
sentences.uz: Sandra, ehtiyot bo'l! O'tir! O'rningdan turma!
sentences.noteUz: Uchta buyruq: ikkitasi tasdiq, bittasi INKOR ('Don't stand up').

sentences.en: OH NO! HELP!!!! DAVID!!! HELP ME!
sentences.uz: VOY! YORDAM BERING!!! DEVID!!! MENGA YORDAM BER!
sentences.noteUz: Sandra suvga yiqildi — epizod nomi shundan: 'The Accident' (baxtsiz hodisa).
Komikslarda tovushni bildiruvchi so'zlar. Inglizchada ular boshqacha: it — 'woof', mushuk — 'meow', qo'ng'iroq — 'ring ring'.

groups.explanationUz: Ishni bajaruvchi odam nomi fe'ldan yasaladi. Ba'zilari -er, ba'zilari -or oladi — buni yodlab olish kerak.
Fe'lga predlog qo'shilsa, ma'no butunlay o'zgaradi. Ularni ALOHIDA so'z kabi yodlash kerak.
Angliya va Shotlandiya joy nomlarida uchraydi.

patterns.formula: There are ... BUT there aren't any ...
patterns.exampleEn: There are stories about the monster in all the papers, but there aren't any photographs!
patterns.exampleUz: Barcha gazetalarda maxluq haqida maqolalar bor, lekin hech qanday surat yo'q!
patterns.explanationUz:
Unit 3 grammatikasi hikoyada ishlatilyapti.
Tasdiqda 'some' yoki hech narsa, inkorda 'any'.

patterns.exampleEn: Is there really a monster, David?
patterns.explanationUz:
'really' shubhani bildiradi — 'rostdan ham?'.
U 'there' va 'a' orasida turadi.

patterns.formula: Can you see ...? — No, I can't.
patterns.exampleEn: Can you see the monster? — No, I can't.
patterns.explanationUz: Qisqa javobda fe'l takrorlanmaydi: 'No, I can't' (I can't see it EMAS).

patterns.exampleEn: Let's hire a boat and look for it.
patterns.explanationUz:
'Let's' = 'let us' — birgalikda qilishga taklif.
Keyin fe'l ASOS shaklida keladi ('to' YO'Q): Let's GO (Let's to go EMAS).

patterns.exampleEn: Look at this! Go to Loch Ness! Sit down!
patterns.exampleUz: Bunga qarang! Loch Nessga boring! O'tir!
patterns.explanationUz:
Buyruqda EGA yo'q — gap to'g'ridan-to'g'ri fe'ldan boshlanadi.
Bu 25-betdagi 'The Imperative' qoidasi.
Inkor buyruq — 'don't' + fe'l. Har doim 'don't' (doesn't EMAS).
